name: Chengchun Shi

affiliation: Department of Statistics, London School of Economics and Political Science
affiliationZh: 伦敦政治经济学院统计系
bio: Associate Professor in LSE's Department of Statistics. His research connects statistics with large language models and reinforcement learning. He is a recipient of the Peter Gavin Hall IMS Early Career Prize, the IMS Tweedie Award, and the Royal Statistical Society Research Prize.
bioZh: 伦敦政治经济学院统计系副教授，研究聚焦统计学与大语言模型、强化学习的交叉。曾获 Peter Gavin Hall IMS Early Career Prize、IMS Tweedie Award 与英国皇家统计学会 Research Prize。

name: Kai Ye
affiliation: Department of Statistics, London School of Economics and Political Science
affiliationZh: 伦敦政治经济学院统计系
bio: Fully funded PhD student in LSE's Department of Statistics. His research spans artificial intelligence, large language models, computer vision, and reinforcement learning, with current work on policy optimisation and partially observable settings.
bioZh: 伦敦政治经济学院统计系全额资助博士生，研究横跨人工智能、大语言模型、计算机视觉与强化学习，当前重点关注策略优化与部分可观测环境。

name: Hongyi Zhou

affiliationZh: 上海财经大学统计与数据科学学院
bio: Assistant Professor at Shanghai University of Finance and Economics. His research spans reinforcement learning, large language models, world models, and classical statistics.

name: Jin Zhu

bio: Assistant Professor in the University of Birmingham's School of Mathematics. His research focuses on large language models, reinforcement learning, and AI-generated content detection, with an emphasis on high-dimensional methods and statistical guarantees.

name: Erhan Xu

affiliationZh: 伦敦政治经济学院统计系
bio: Fully funded PhD student in LSE's Department of Statistics. His research connects reinforcement learning, large language models, and economics and econometrics, with an emphasis on statistically principled alignment and reasoning-model post-training.
bioZh: 伦敦政治经济学院统计系全额资助博士生，研究连接强化学习、大语言模型与经济学及计量经济学，重点关注具有统计原理的模型对齐和推理模型后训练。
